name: fixed-tests-and-check
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test core/count-recovery/member-premises.test.ts core/count-recovery/member-inclusions.test.ts core/count-witness-flags.test.ts; bun run check

name: check-returned-proof
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/incl-debug.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; MLDR_INCL_VARIANT=member-premises-debug MLDR_INCL_FAMILY=generated DUMP_DIR="$tmp" DUMP_MIN=0 DUMP_N=100000 DUMP_ALL=1 timeout -s KILL 45 bun --preload ./research/query/dump.ts --preload ./research/track-p/capture.ts --preload ./research/mldr-incl/premise-trace.ts research/mldr-incl/conditional-safety.ts family-input/family-first.json 6000 no; bun research/mldr-incl/pack-capture.ts "$tmp" 160000
